note: Messages that reach the prompt hook but were not typed by the user. Whole <tag>...</tag> blocks of these tags are removed before the search; if nothing of the user's own is left, the hook prints nothing. Prefixes mark harness messages that carry no request. Add a tag only with evidence of it in real transcripts; users can add more with hook_skip_tags in their config.
